data.one_liner: Common WebRTC interfaces and type definitions for Flutter and Dart Web.
data.what_it_does: Defines shared interfaces, types, and abstract classes for WebRTC implementations across Dart and Flutter platforms. It standardizes APIs like RTCPeerConnection, RTCDataChannel, and MediaStream for platform-specific implementations. It serves primarily as a foundation contract for packages like flutter_webrtc rather than an end-user client library.
use_when: Building or extending a WebRTC platform implementation or plugin for Flutter/Dart
Writing cross-platform abstractions that depend strictly on WebRTC interfaces without concrete bindings
avoid_when: Building standard WebRTC features directly in an application, where full implementations like flutter_webrtc or dart_webrtc are needed
strengths: Zero dependencies, lightweight pure Dart interface package
Covers comprehensive WebRTC APIs including frame encryption, media recording, and priority controls
weaknesses: Contains only interfaces and stubs without actual runtime WebRTC implementations
Minimal documentation and no usage examples in the README

alternatives.name: dart_webrtc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a full, functional WebRTC implementation for Dart rather than just an interface layer
